nodes.summary: For finite `E`, the mass of a configuration is the product of its coordinate masses.
nodes.title: Mass of a configuration under a finite Bernoulli product measure

nodes.summary: `bernoulliMeasure p hp` is Mathlib's `ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure true false p`.
nodes.title: Bernoulli distribution agrees with the library Bernoulli measure

nodes.summary: The mass of a point under the Bernoulli distribution: `p` at `true`, `1 - p` at `false`.
nodes.title: Point masses of the Bernoulli distribution

nodes.summary: The Bernoulli distribution on `Bool` with success probability `p`: mass `p` on `true` and `1 - p` on `false`. This is Mathlib's `ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure true false p`, with the parameter given as an `ℝ≥0` bounded by `1`.
nodes.title: Bernoulli distribution on the Booleans

nodes.summary: The infinite Bernoulli product measure of a cylinder over `F` is the finite Bernoulli product measure of its base.
nodes.title: Bernoulli product measure of a cylinder event

nodes.summary: On bond configurations `Sym2 V → Bool`, `bernoulliProductMeasure` is the bond percolation law `MathlibExt.Probability.ProductBondPercolation.gbernoulliLaw`.
nodes.title: Bernoulli product measure on bonds is the bond percolation law

nodes.summary: The Bernoulli product measure on `ConfigSpace E`: the coordinates are independent and each is `true` with probability `p` (`Measure.infinitePi` of `bernoulliMeasure p hp`). See also Mathlib's `ProbabilityTheory.setBernoulli`, the same product measure on `Set E`.
nodes.title: Bernoulli product measure on configuration space

nodes.summary: Russo's formula, `deriv` form of `hasDerivAt_realProb_cylinder_pivotal`.
nodes.title: Russo's formula

nodes.summary: The weight of the projection of an event onto finitely many coordinates is differentiable in `p`.
nodes.title: Differentiability in $p$ of the probability of a cylinder event

nodes.summary: An event whose indicator depends only on the coordinates in `F` is the cylinder over its projection onto `F`.
nodes.title: Events depending on finitely many coordinates are cylinders

nodes.summary: The configuration that agrees with `η` on the finite set `F` and with `ω` off `F`.
nodes.title: Configuration patched from one configuration on a finite set and another off it

nodes.summary: On a finite index set, the Bernoulli product measure of an event is its weight `prob p`.
nodes.title: Bernoulli product measure of an event on a finite index set

nodes.summary: Russo's formula for an increasing event `A` projected onto finitely many coordinates `F`: the derivative in `p` of its weight is the sum over `e ∈ F` of the weight of the event that `e` is pivotal (L. Russo, 1981).
nodes.title: Russo's formula

nodes.summary: The projection of an increasing event onto finitely many coordinates is increasing.
nodes.title: Finite projections of increasing events are increasing

nodes.summary: For finite `E`, the probability of an event is the sum of the masses of its configurations.
nodes.title: Probability of an event as a sum of configuration masses

nodes.summary: The probability of an event depending only on the coordinates in `F`, as an explicit polynomial in `p`.
nodes.title: Probability of a finitely dependent event as a polynomial in $p$

nodes.summary: The probability of an event depending only on the coordinates in `F` is the finite weight `prob p` of its projection onto `F`.
nodes.title: Probability of a finitely dependent event as a finite weight

nodes.summary: Real-valued form of `bernoulliProductMeasure_cylinder`.
nodes.title: Bernoulli product measure of a cylinder event, real-valued form

nodes.summary: On a finite index set, the mass of a configuration is its product weight `configWeight`.
nodes.title: Mass of a configuration on a finite index set is its product weight

nodes.summary: The configuration weights of a Bernoulli product measure are log-modular: `w(a) w(b) = w(a ⊔ b) w(a ⊓ b)`. In particular they satisfy the FKG lattice condition.
nodes.title: Log-modularity of Bernoulli product weights

nodes.summary: Configuration masses are nonnegative.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of configuration masses

nodes.summary: For finite `E`, the mass of a configuration is the product of its coordinate masses.
nodes.title: Mass of a configuration under a finite Bernoulli product measure, real form

nodes.summary: For finite `E`, the configuration masses sum to `1`.
nodes.title: Configuration masses sum to one
